Carriers of this gene see much better low light than well lit areas, and are unaffected by mood penalties related to darkness. They have a reflective layer behind the retina that amplifies their ability to see in the dark.
Carriers of this gene can dodge attacks very easily. Extra-capable in perception, they anticipate attacks before they happen.
Carriers of this gene have hands that partially resemble talons. This reduces their ability to manipulate objects, but allows them to perform special attacks in melee combat.
Carriers of this gene are extremely territorial and will feel more calm in their own land, and at the same time increasingly uneasy as they leave it.
Carriers of this gene are able to excrete a thick toxic smoke from special organic reservoirs in their lungs. Tox gas is deadly to almost every creature.
Carriers of this gene have pointy bat-like ears.
Carriers grow glands in the neck that generate and store a thick goo. They can spit it over long distances and cover several people in a viscous goo that will slow them down.
Carriers of this gene can perform a wicked warhowl, using a powerful bellow and psychic connection to call on their allies to fight more aggressively.
Carriers of this gene have webbed fingers and toes, allowing them to move faster in water. Webbed fingers slightly reduce fine motor control.
Carriers of this gene heal from wounds twice as fast as normal.
Carriers of this gene heal from wounds half as fast as normal.
Carriers of this gene heal from wounds four times as fast as normal.

Carriers of this gene can implant a copy of their xenogerm into another person through a somewhat gross-looking injector organ. Their own genetic material will then regrow very slowly. If they implant while their genes are regrowing, they will die. Germline genes will be unaffected.
